title: Ratchet & Clank: Ranger Rumble pulled from stores 📱
subject: ratchetandclank
description:
Did you ever get to play it? 👇

Sony Interactive Entertainment removed the mobile arena shooter Ratchet & Clank: Ranger Rumble from the App Store and Google Play on November 21, after cancelling it on November 6. Servers shut down May 1, 2027. Series footage shown is from Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart.

Sources: official Ranger Rumble announcement via Gematsu (Nov 6, 2026), Final Weapon (Nov 6, 2026), Screen Rant (Nov 18, 2026)
Game footage © Sony Interactive Entertainment.

scenes.text: A Ratchet & Clank game just vanished from phone stores.
On November 21, Sony pulled Ratchet & Clank: Ranger Rumble from the App Store and Google Play.
The free-to-play arena shooter, made by Oh BiBi, never launched in the US. It only soft-launched in places like the Philippines, Canada and the UK.
Sony cancelled it on November 6, removed in-app purchases and made the Super Pass free.
Existing players can keep going until May 1, 2027, when the servers shut down for good.
